causal_boundaries.local_deletion: A controlled contribution is supported within this paired run, not a unique explanation for the previous run.
causal_boundaries.world_scale: Weighted world gradients dominate on recorded world events; the finding is a diagnostic, not a proven cause of endpoint degradation.
causal_boundaries.clipping: 240/240 world events clip, but no unclipped/normalized causal control exists; clipping coefficient does not equal AdamW parameter step scaling.
causal_boundaries.noise: Both measured noise bands degrade for A/C; training noise time is bound to correction variant and event counts differ64/56. No high-noise-only causal claim.
causal_boundaries.probe_definition: One denoising prediction from a noisy TRAIN teacher trajectory plus saved coupled endpoint propagation; not 16-step DDIM or DEV.
causal_boundaries.pose_objective: Squared aggregate loss improvement does not imply every position and orientation inequality improves or passes.
